nativeUi.implementation: A fourth profile metadata row gets its own native screen-layer key while reusing the existing Scouting subscreen as a read-only presentation donor. Its original controls are hidden for Notes and restored for normal Scouting.
nativeUi.input: Notes and Scouting share the donor state. The category callback avoids locking input for a no-op state transition. The scout action and scout-button focus updates are guarded while Notes is selected.
nativeUi.refresh: Recruit selection and active-recruit updates rebuild the selected Notes body's native text label
nativeUi.ownership: Fingerprint-gated native invocation-setup hook. Matches method metadata, then verifies all eight complete method bodies in the loaded APT stream before redirecting only the live receiver. No cached object addresses or memory scans are used.
nativeUi.sharedHooks: Does not replace Social Media’s script-body accessor hook or alter the Dynasty hub. The invocation-setup hook forwards all five native arguments and the return value unchanged.
nativeUi.unloading: Clean game restart required once the Notes UI candidate is installed, because native script clones can retain its definitions and DLL-backed literals
nativeUi.lifetime: Recruiting unloads its script objects and source asset on exit. Each new source generation is verified on entry; retained definitions preserve that generation’s native parameters and constant pool. At most 16 asset generations per process.
nativeUi.layout: Stage-coordinate text stays anchored to saved native widget positions; unused native divider lines are hidden in Notes and restored in Scouting. The initial Scouting tab label reserves its longest percentage width before Notes is laid out.
nativeUi.binding: GetActiveRecruit returns a RecordId. Notes resolves it through the native GetTeamRecruitList response with ArrayUtil.Search before reading DENotesBody.
